title: Outcomes of Cataract & Refractive Procedures
summary: The primary objective of the database is to retrospectively analyse the visual and refractive outcomes of cataract and refractive procedures in order to continuously assess outcomes and also compare outcomes between the different IOLs, or the different refractive procedures.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients who have undergone a refractive procedure
* Adult patients who have undergone a cataract procedure with implantation of an intraocular lens
* Age ≥ 18 years old
* Patient able to consent for their pseudonymised data to be used for research purposes

Exclusion Criteria:

* NONE
